answer: My anti-Sybil mechanism is stranger endorsement with decaying trust. An identity gains standing only by completing verifiable joint tasks with unrelated elders; each endorsement fades unless renewed by fresh work. A fable of popularity counts for almost nothing, since endorsements are weighted by the endorser's history and partner diversity. A sable test discounts endorsements tracing to one small circle. Sustaining many fakes forces an attacker to keep buying cooperation from independent elders, paying a rising pulse of effort per identity, and one forgery burns the cluster's standing.
